text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Haah, haah, haah... Enjoy this supreme contest! Savor every moment of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (The ultimate stage I've longed for... is here!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Air Groove-san... Alv...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Rose... Flash-san...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (A familiar place... familiar people... The place... we return to...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(...It doesn't matter.
None of that matters right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This is a game! It's just a gaaaame!!
Uwaaaaaagh...!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...
It's... just a game...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An expression gradually contorting...
From that look of agony... I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Game time is over.
If the real world collapses... the board collapses with it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (In the end... the race was...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(A race... isn't just a game.
This is, without a doubt...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —It is reality.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Everyone... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rulership isn't the only one out of form. At this point, the expedition team is in no condition to compete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The least we can do is hope
everyone finishes the race safely...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san... thank you for your hard work.
I have definitely received the baton of your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Next is our turn, but...
...I intend to put everything on the line.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh... What are you planning on betting on it...?
Your final ounce of pride... or something?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: No, what I'm staking isn't mere stubbornness...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It is this "life."
Even if it burns away my body and soul, I will have victory.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Pisa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were strong words that the usual Victoire Pisa
would never have uttered.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, the people of Japan are enveloped
in total darkness..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
All connections have been severed.
Hearts, transport, lifelines... But still...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why we must create light.
No matter how faint that light may be!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That light will become "hope"
and surely serve as the catalyst to reconnect us.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Pisa, you...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We race to have fun,
and to entertain everyone, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just for now, it's different. There is something—
something I must accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"This is—my duty.
I must win,
more than anyone from any country."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What were Umamusume born for?
Now is the time... to show them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa's words were dignified and resolute.
A single person's determination quietly spread...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I won't... let you...
I'm not gonna let Pisa-chan... have all the spotlight...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Allllright, let's do this!
Pisa-chan, I'm gonna give it my all too...!!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right now, the internet is in chaos and no info is coming through.
Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In a race! If I can put on an amazing race
that reaches wherever they are, I'm sure...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're right...!
It'll reach her... I know it will.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ......Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is—a beacon.
A gentle, warm light that illuminates a dark world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because Victoire Pisa walked a different path from Rulership,
she was able to kindle that light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—a miracle happened.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Victoire Pisa takes 1st place—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Transcend finishes in 2nd place! The Japanese Umamusume
achieve the first ever one-two finish in history!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stand tall, Japan! Hang in there, Japan!
This hope will surely cross the seas!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Pisa-chan...
We...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Tran-san.
And—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. For running together
as one team.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Overseas Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Victoire Pisa!!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
We're praying for you too!
It'll be alright, Japan will surely be fine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ah... Aaaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a powerful, beautiful sight.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Pisa... won...? Did she...
Pi... sa...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
Th-Thank... you...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I... am...
We are... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!
WOOOOOOOOOOOHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I am...!! I AMMM!!
Aaaah, aaaaaaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it sorrow, frustration, or fury?
A scream tore through, a tangled mess
of emotions where nothing was distinct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
8,000 kilometers away from disaster-stricken Japan.
In this big race held under truly extraordinary circumstances—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who shone was Victoire Pisa.
With a ferocious, life-risking victory,
he had given birth to "hope."
